tickerText: [TENNIS] Gauff & Fils take Cincinnati; Sinner withdraws from US Open as Zheng & Andreescu advance in qualifying • [SQUASH] PSA Budapest Open underway — Ng tops Copper draw with London Classic looming Sep 1 • [BADMINTON] France's BWF Worlds double: Lanier & Gicquel/Delrue; An Se-young tops Yamaguchi • [PICKLEBALL] Canes & Cup Pro-Am Sept 3 pairs Hurricanes stars with PPA pros; Veolia Nationals open season Aug 31 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao Sep 8–13 draws 64 elite singles players; Lebrun & Wang Manyu fresh off Malmö Grand Smash

newsItems.title: Cincinnati Crowns & US Open Qualifying
newsItems.excerpt: Coco Gauff and Arthur Fils won Cincinnati Masters titles as Jannik Sinner withdrew from the US Open; Zheng Qinwen and Bianca Andreescu are among those advancing through qualifying.

newsItems.title: France's Historic BWF Worlds Double
newsItems.excerpt: Alex Lanier and Thom Gicquel/Delphine Delrue delivered France's first men's singles and mixed doubles world titles, while An Se-young reclaimed the women's crown over Akane Yamaguchi.

newsItems.title: Canes & Cup Pro-Am at Veolia Nationals
newsItems.excerpt: Carolina Hurricanes Stanley Cup champions join top PPA pros for the Canes and the Cup Pro-Am on Sept 3, kicking off the Veolia Pickleball National Championships in Cary.

newsItems.title: WTT Macao Draws Elite Field
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Macao runs Sep 8–13 with 64 top singles players chasing 1,000 ranking points, as Felix Lebrun and Wang Manyu arrive off Malmö Grand Smash titles.
